subject: Procurement gateways & payments — action plan and timeline
messages:
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@skybridge.ai>, SkyBridge Procurement <procurement@skybridge.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-22T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: Procurement gateways & payments — action plan and timeline

Hi Sophie / SkyBridge procurement team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great context on the use case (real-time summarization for support queues) and the financial cadence. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned on the commercial path and procurement milestones: 

1) Commercial/payment path options
- Preferred for SkyBridge: purchase order (PO) via finance (you indicated procurement will issue a PO rather than a card).
- Alternative: charge card for initial pilot (we can accept card for under-$10k pilots).
- Marketplace: you mentioned interest in AWS Marketplace — we can support Marketplace billing which simplifies procurement for many customers.

2) Typical procurement milestone map (example timeline)
- Legal review (standard terms or SOW): ~7–14 business days depending on redlines
- Security & compliance review (docs + questionnaire): 3–7 business days once we provide artifacts
- Finance approval & budget sign-off: customer-driven (we’ve seen 5–15 business days)
- PO issuance: immediate after finance sign-off

Target: mutual goal to have PO and procurement gating complete by 2026-03-18 so production pilot can start by end of March. Let me know if that target is aggressive for you.

3) Immediate asks from Redwood (what we will provide)
- I’ll attach a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and owners. (mutual_action_plan.xlsx)
- Security overview & SOC2 artifacts summary (redwood-security-overview.pdf)
- Sample SOW and pricing breakdown for a 3-month pilot (sample-sow-redwood.docx)

4) Please confirm:
- Preferred payment method (PO vs card) — you mentioned PO in the call but wanted to confirm
- Whether you want us to pursue AWS Marketplace listing earlier in the process (we can initiate in parallel, but it doesn’t replace your internal PO timeline)
- Primary procurement contact and expected budget-approval date (cc’ing the procurement alias would help)

Next steps: I’ll upload the MAP and security packet to the Drive link and loop in our contracts lead if/when legal needs to engage. If it’s helpful, I propose a 20-min follow-up on Feb 29 to check status and confirm owners.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, redwood-security-overview.pdf, sample-sow-redwood.docx
From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@skybridge.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: SkyBridge Procurement <procurement@skybridge.ai>, Evan Cole <evan.cole@skybridge.ai>
Date: 2026-02-23T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement gateways & payments — action plan and timeline

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Payment method: PO preferred. We can do card for pilot if we need to move faster, but procurement will push for PO.
- Marketplace: yes, AWS Marketplace would be ideal long-term. If you can initiate that process now, we’ll consider Marketplace subscription for the production phase.
- Procurement contact: Evan Cole (cc’d) is our procurement lead. Evan — can you confirm expected SLAs for legal (redline turn) + finance approval cadence?

High-level timeline from our side:
- Legal review: we generally allocate ~10 business days for vendor contract review unless material redlines appear.
- Security review: if you share the security overview and completed questionnaire, our InfoSec team can triage within ~5 business days.
- Finance/PO: budget cycle closes mid-March (targeting 3/16–3/18). If Legal + Security are complete by then, procurement should be able to issue a PO the week of 3/18.

Deliverables we need from Redwood:
- SOW + line-item pricing (we’ll need a clear cost breakdown by month and by token/usage assumption)
- SOC2 / security questionnaire answers (can be redacted)

I’ll coordinate with Evan and procurement@skybridge.ai on any additional paperwork. Agree on a 2/29 check-in — please send an invite.

Best,
Sophie Lane
Head of Product | SkyBridge AI
Sophie.Lane@skybridge.ai
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@skybridge.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: SkyBridge Procurement <procurement@skybridge.ai>
Date: 2026-02-23T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement gateways & payments — action plan and timeline

Sophie / team — happy to jump in. A few notes from contracts & partnerships perspective: 

- Marketplace: Redwood has an AWS Marketplace listing in progress; we can fast-track the listing metadata and procurement docs so your procurement team can subscribe via Marketplace. Marketplace procurement often shortens billing approvals but does not always eliminate the need for a PO on your side depending on internal policy.
- SOW: I’m attaching our standard pilot SOW template (sample-sow-redwood.docx). Pricing model we recommend for your use case is: fixed monthly seat + per-1M-token tranche; we’ll include conservative token estimates for the pilot.
- Legal redlines: for pilot engagements we accept a limited set of redlines (data handling and IP), but if you need enterprise-level modifications we’ll route to legal and expect ~10 business days for review.

Proposed MAP milestones (we’ll update the spreadsheet Karthik shared):
- 2/24: Redwood sends final SOW + pricing + completed security questionnaire
- 3/04: SkyBridge legal + InfoSec initial pass (comments consolidated)
- 3/11: Legal and security clearance complete
- 3/16: Finance budget sign-off
- 3/18: PO issued

Attachments referenced: sample-sow-redwood.docx (attached in this thread)

Lauren Bishop
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@skybridge.ai>, SkyBridge Procurement <procurement@skybridge.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-24T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement gateways & payments — action plan and timeline

Thanks Sophie — this is perfect. Quick internal note and next steps: 

- Rafael: can you take point on the SOW + full security packet (completed questionnaire, SOC2 summary, and artifact index)? Aim to send by end of day 2/24 as we discussed.
- I’ll put a 20-min sync on 2026-02-29 to go over any open items and confirm the MAP dates above. Invite will be external-friendly so Evan/procurement can join.
- Lauren: please start Marketplace intake in parallel and confirm what we can share with procurement for a faster subscription path.

Appreciate the quick coordination — we’ll keep this moving toward the 3/18 PO target.

Karthik
